itens.trecho: Assisti à pré-estreia com altas expectativas — e saí impactada. Acerto Final entrega ação de tirar o fôlego, uma trama bem amarrada e um encerramento digno para a saga de Ethan Hunt. O flashback inicial conecta todos os filmes da franquia, o que facilita até para quem nunca acompanhou a série entender tudo.
Whenever a film playing in theaters is introduced by one of the members of the picture’s creative team, it’s a safe bet that it doesn’t live up to its pre-release hype.

My quick rating - 7.2/10. You’d think a 170-minute movie would have plenty of time to waste, but Mission: Impossible - The Final Reckoning sprints out of the gate and doesn’t look back. For something that clocks in at nearly three hours, it’s almost shocking how quickly it moves.
